name: Beach Episode
source:
Soaking up the holiday sun, Oceana and her friend spend their time at the beach. In this new setting, they meet new people and new feelings begin to blossom. Who will you end the holiday with?

[Translated from [url=https://pinkbunny-strawberry.itch.io/beach-episode]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
沐浴着假日的明媚阳光，奥希安娜与好友在海滩边悠闲度日。在这片崭新的天地里，她们结识了新的伙伴，懵懂的情愫也悄然萌芽。在假期的尾声，你将与谁携手相伴？

[译自[url=https://pinkbunny-strawberry.itch.io/beach-episode]itch.io[/url]]
